description: Rebecca Haehn, Niklas Kotowski, Philipp Ahrendt and Erika Ábrahám publish Considering Uncertainty in Railway Systems, abbreviated CURSe. The software implements symbolic simulation of delay propagation in railway systems, with a graphical interface, runtime reduction of train instances and a feasible-path algorithm. Zenodo lists CURSe.zip, published in July 2022 and available free under CC BY 4.0. Three linked conference papers describe the methods. The public metadata establish a reusable railway model but do not specify the programming language, runtime, input schema, benchmark geography or simulation horizon. Those coverage and technical details remain unknown. A modeller could use the package to examine how train delays interact with network constraints, subject to checking the archive documentation. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. No software was downloaded or executed.
